IC1: Patients attending for a therapeutic endoscopic procedure e.g. variceal banding [OR], stent insertion [OR], balloon dilatation.
IC2: Patients with a known diagnosis e.g. upper gastrointestinal cancer
IC3: Patients previously treated with HP eradication therapy
IC4: Patients who had taken PPI [OR], H2 receptor antagonists [OR] and antibiotics within 4 weeks
IC6: Patients who'd had previous gastric surgery
IC8: Patients with abnormal coagulation [OR] or any other contra-indication [AND] to use of standard biopsy in routine diagnostic endoscopic procedures
IC9: Patients who are unable or unwilling to give informed consent
IC10: Patients under the age of 18 years
